lines.label: B1
lines.reason: The ~90.7 deg plate-to-flange fold (outer skin: plate face 2 and flange face 3). In sections at 25/50/75% the label sits on the convex outer apex, 0.16/0.10/0.04 mm from the nearest surface point, with nothing beyond it outward and the inner skin about 1.4 mm inward along the bisector. The apex surface runs t=0.6..149.8 mm along the 150.9 mm line with no gaps. The line overhangs the fold ends at the reliefs by only about 1 mm, so it covers the full fold.

lines.label: B2
lines.reason: The ~44 deg flange-to-tab fold at the +x end (tab 5/6), which counts under the 10 deg rule. In sections at 25/50/75% the label sits on the convex outer apex (flange face 4 and tab face 6), 0.13/0.03/0.01 mm from the surface, with the inner skin about 1.42 mm inward. Apex points cover t=-0.2..17.7 over the 17.6 mm line, which is the full tab width between the plate-side relief notch and the free edge.

lines.label: B3
lines.reason: The ~44 deg flange-to-tab fold at the -x end (tab 7/8), mirroring B2. In sections at 25/50/75% the label sits on the outer apex, 0.03/0.14/0.18 mm from the surface. Apex points cover t=-0.1..17.7 over the 17.57 mm line, which is the full tab width. It is parallel to the fold, with no gaps.
